name: solana-launch-safety
description: Hosts observed draining wallets of Solana token creators or impersonating Solmint (solmint.dev), with evidence, plus look-alike names kept for disambiguation. Maintained by RaptorLabs.

categories.drainer: Served, loaded or backed a wallet-draining kit at the time of observation. Evidence is a saved copy of the code or a public verdict by a third party.
categories.impersonation: Presented itself as Solmint or used Solmint's names, handles or wording to mislead users. No wallet-draining behaviour was observed unless stated.
categories.third-party-blocklist: Listed by a wallet or security vendor before Solmint existed under that name. Included so users understand the entry is not ours.
categories.lookalike-suspended: A look-alike name that its registrar has suspended. Kept for the record.
categories.lookalike-watch: A registered look-alike name with no content or activity observed at the last review. Not affiliated with solmint.dev. No concern is implied.
categories.not-affiliated: A separate service or site with a similar name. Not affiliated with solmint.dev. No concern is implied; listed only so people can tell the names apart.

entries.observed: The page at /?app=spoodle rendered a bare 'Connect Wallet' prompt that loaded https://blank-ckd.pages.dev/blank.js and sent a beacon to walletadapter-cdn-cloud.com, a pattern consistent with a wallet-draining kit. A copy of the loader was saved on 2026-10-19.
also_listed_by: Cloudflare: restricted on 2026-10-19 after an abuse report
entries.notes: The domain changed registrar on 2026-06-26 and the same loader runs on unrelated domains. No statement is made about who operates it.

entries.status: restricted: the loader at /blank.js now answers HTTP 404; Cloudflare restricted it on 2026-10-19 with a 'Suspected Malware' interstitial

entries.observed: Registered 2026-09-27. Used the 'SoLMintDev' name that Solmint uses on its social accounts, mirrored Solmint's page title and published fabricated statistics (400,000+ tokens, 25,000+ users, 'Secure & Audited'). Its public token endpoint showed eight tokens ever. No wallet-draining code was found in its bundle.
also_listed_by: Cloudflare: restricted on 2026-10-17 after an abuse report
entries.notes: Reported as impersonation with deceptive claims, not as theft.

A separate token-creation service operating under a near-identical name since 2025, listed in Phantom's app directory as 'Solmint.net'. It has no relationship with solmint.dev or RaptorLabs. No wallet-draining behaviour was observed on it.
entries.notes: Listed so that people searching for Solmint can tell the two names apart. Its subdomains opensource.solmint.net and api.solmint.net belong to the same service.
